overall_reason: One blue, #4c76b4 with shades #426da9 and #7598cb, colours the heading, the price, the labels, every border, the badge, the button and the shadows, so no colour is left for ink and the accent marks nothing.

score.reason: T-ACCENT-DOSAGE finds the accent on every text element and border, and T-PALETTE-ROLES finds no neutral text level at all; the hue itself is a muted, non-stock blue.

findings.title: The accent marks action and state
findings.where: the plan card, every element, 1440 and 375, tiles/1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table lists one chromatic group, #4c76b4, on 8 elements (5 text, 2 fills, 1 border), with #426da9 on the heading 'Starter plan', the price '$24', '/ month', 'Team seats' and '3 of 5 seats'. Neutral text levels: 0. Both shadow recipes are tinted the same blue (rgba(61,105,162,0.18) and 0.267).
findings.before: The accent is the ink, the border colour, the badge fill, the button fill and the shadow tint.
findings.after: Ink for headings, price and labels; the accent held to 'Manage plan' and the 'Active' state.
findings.why: When everything is blue, the button and the active badge have nothing to stand out from.

findings.title: Regions use the lowest rung of the surface ladder
findings.where: the three inner boxes (plan row, price, team seats) inside the outer card, 1440, tiles/1440-00.png
findings.evidence: Hiding the three inner blue borders loses no grouping, since spacing already separates the rows. The plan row adds a pale fill #eff4fc on top of its border, and the outer card has its own blue border.
findings.before: Three accent-bordered boxes inside an accent-bordered card.
findings.after: One container, with rows separated by space or one neutral hairline.
findings.why: Accent-coloured lines on every box spend the accent on structure.

findings.title: State colours keep their meaning
findings.evidence: The badge and the button share the fill #4c76b4 with white text.
findings.before: The current state and the primary action share one fill.
findings.after: A state treatment distinct from the action fill, for example a tinted badge with accent text.
findings.why: The badge reads as a second button.

strengths: The single blue is a muted, non-stock hue held in one hue family with stepped shades.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
